fixed_findings: P1: validate actual IPv4 header length and complete ICMP header before reading reply identifiers
P1: verified PEAP requires compiled certificate date checks and a set clock; expired and future certificates fail
P2: ping uses a monotonic total deadline and bounded receive slices despite unrelated ICMP traffic
P2: use per-interface DHCP DNS; unsupported global-only configurations require an explicit DNS address for named targets
P2: HTTP skips bounded informational responses and evaluates the final status; unsupported 101 is rejected

host_regression.sanitizers: AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer on host test programs
host_regression.ping: Full production ping source with synthetic socket/clock: all IPv4 IHL values and capture lengths through 68 bytes, reply/source/type filtering, continuous unrelated traffic, timeout and cancellation
host_regression.tls: Real mbedTLS handshakes with date checks enabled; expired/future certificate rejection, unset/reset clock, wrong name/CA and explicit unverified mode. Separate mbedTLS build with date checks disabled rejects verified mode.
host_regression.dns: Both per-interface and global-only compile configurations exercised; no global DNS read in the unsupported branch; explicit override and literal IPv4 tests pass
host_regression.http: 103 then 500 fails; 100/103 then 204 passes; interim-only, malformed, truncated and excessive interim responses fail
